card: This pull request cleans up the mempool_compatibility.py functional test following previous backwards-compatibility test updates. It drops an explicit raw P2PK wallet mode override and block sync workarounds, and asserts that unbroadcast transaction persistence works when loading mempools across node versions. This is an internal test maintenance change with no effect on node behavior or user-facing features.
evidence: PR description: 'The MiniWallet mode can be dropped (using the default), now that all nodes support taproot. The `sync_fun=self.no_op` can be dropped... A check for the unbroadcast set can be added, now that all nodes support persisting the set.'
problem: The test contains outdated workarounds for older node versions that lacked Taproot support and unbroadcast persistence, and it did not verify that the unbroadcast set is correctly read by the older node.

risk.why: A mistake would only cause a failure in the mempool compatibility functional test.

summary: Cleans up the `mempool_compatibility.py` functional test following updates to tested node versions. It removes the explicit `RAW_P2PK` MiniWallet mode override, drops `sync_fun=self.no_op` workarounds by connecting the nodes earlier, and adds a test assertion verifying that unbroadcast transaction status persists across mempool dumps.
